description: This Java class defines EmptyResult, a subclass of Result, representing an immutable, empty result in the OpenMRS logic result framework. It overrides methods to prevent modification and indicates that the result is empty and null.

classes.name: EmptyResult
classes.description: A subclass of Result that represents an immutable, empty result set. All mutator methods throw ImmutableResultException to prevent modifications. It indicates that the result is empty and null.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Overrides the add method to throw ImmutableResultException, preventing addition of elements by index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Overrides the add method to throw ImmutableResultException, preventing addition of elements.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Overrides addAll to throw ImmutableResultException, preventing adding a collection of results.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Overrides addAll with index to throw ImmutableResultException.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Overrides clear() to throw ImmutableResultException, preventing clearing the result.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this result is always empty.

methods.name: toBoolean
methods.description: Returns Boolean.FALSE, representing the logical false value.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this result is considered null.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Overrides remove by index to throw ImmutableResultException.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overrides set method to throw ImmutableResultException, preventing modification of existing entries.
